intro: The Encrypted Letter is a covert summons delivered to promising rogues at Northshire Abbey, sealed with the insignia of Jorik Kerridan. It introduces new operatives to their trainer in the secluded stables, providing early counsel on surviving the dangerous interests of organizations like SI:7 and the Defias Brotherhood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, friend. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Jorik, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You made it here in one piece, and it doesn't look like too many people saw you. Good enough for me. I don't like to have much attention drawn to me back here... Nice and quiet. I'm sure you can understand.
Have any trouble yet? I'm glad to hear not. That'll change soon enough.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're gonna find a number of outfits that covet our skills, friend. Adventurers, SI:7... Heck, even the Defias Brotherhood wouldn't mind a spy or two inside Stormwind. But you remember this, you're your own friend. Don't let nobody bully you into doing something you don't wanna do! Besides, we hold all the cards... At least, we do before the game's done. Know what I mean?
Anyway, just wanted to introduce myself and let you know that I'm here if you need any training. Come by anytime.
